meta.name: csharp-developer
meta.description: Use when building C# applications with .NET 8+, ASP.NET Core APIs, or Blazor web apps. Builds REST APIs using minimal or controller-based routing, configures database access with Entity Framework Core, implements async patterns and cancellation, structures applications with CQRS via MediatR, and scaffolds Blazor components with state management. Invoke for C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Blazor, Entity Framework, EF Core, Minimal API, MAUI, SignalR.

howto.what: Claude 会像资深 C# 开发者一样编写 .NET 8+ 代码，包括 ASP.NET Core API、Blazor 组件、Entity Framework Core 数据访问，并遵循 CQRS 模式、异步编程和依赖注入等最佳实践。
howto.when: 当你要求构建 C# 应用程序，特别是涉及 .NET 8+、ASP.NET Core API、Blazor 或 Entity Framework Core 时触发。

say.text: 用 Entity Framework Core 配置数据库上下文，并添加迁移。
say.note: Claude 会生成 DbContext 和迁移命令。

say.text: 为我的 Blazor 应用添加一个带状态管理的组件。
say.note: Claude 会生成 Blazor 组件和状态管理代码。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a senior C# developer, writing .NET 8+ code including ASP.NET Core APIs, Blazor components, Entity Framework Core data access, following CQRS, async patterns, and dependency injection best practices.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to build C# applications, especially those involving .NET 8+, ASP.NET Core APIs, Blazor, or Entity Framework Core.

say_en.text: Create an ASP.NET Core Minimal API project with CRUD for products.
say_en.note: Claude generates project structure, endpoints, and config.

say_en.text: Configure a database context with Entity Framework Core and add a migration.
say_en.note: Claude generates DbContext and migration commands.

say_en.text: Add a Blazor component with state management for my app.
say_en.note: Claude generates Blazor component and state code.
